summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Agomab Therapeutics NV reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held on May 26, 2026. All agenda items were approved, including the reappointment of two board members. This is a routine post-meeting report with no special situation triggered—no forced departure, M&A, or corporate action. It is the equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report on Form 8-K for an AGM result. No deal terms, premiums, or structural changes are involved. This filing is purely informational and does not constitute a special situation.
